name: artifact-retention
description: After a build is delivered, delete its intermediate copies and old versions — keep exactly the version that runs and one previous for rollback — and report the space freed as measured by `df`, never `du`. Covers local build output, mobile build caches, container images, release dirs and stale browser-session copies, with a never-delete list (volumes, databases, installed SDKs, simulator runtimes, the rollback version).
